author: Linnaeus, 1758
status: 나그네새, 해마다 수십 마리 · 겨울에도 드물게 기록(10건 미만)
summary: 매우 드물게 지나가는 나그네새로, 관목이 드문드문 자라고 땅의 높낮이가 심한 습지에서 지낸다. 겨울에는 홀로, 여름에는 암수가 함께 주로 땅 위에서 생활한다. 곤충, 환형동물, 복족류 같은 동물성 먹이와 여러 식물의 열매를 먹으며, 산란기는 5~7월이고 한배에 알을 5~7개, 때로는 8~9개 낳는다. 국외에서는 동남아시아, 러시아, 중국, 알래스카 서부에 분포한다.

sexes.male: 봄철 수컷은 턱밑·멱·앞목이 푸르고, 그 가운데보다 조금 아래쪽에 짙은 붉은 녹슨색의 큰 얼룩이 있다.
sexes.female: 윗면은 수컷과 같다. 턱밑과 멱은 흰 바탕에 붉은 녹슨빛 얼룩점이 조금 있고, 그 아래로 검은 띠와 흰 띠가 차례로 놓이며 다소 푸른빛을 띤다. 가슴에는 얼룩무늬가 있다.

art.subject: Bluethroat (Luscinia svecica), adult male in spring, red-spotted form, as seen in Korean marshes in April and May: plain earth-brown upperparts, the crown and nape sepia-brown with darker feather centres; a long creamy-buff supercilium; black lores and rusty-brown ear coverts; chin, throat and foreneck bright cobalt-blue with a large rusty-red spot in the lower centre of the blue; below the blue a narrow black band, a thin white band and a broad rusty-chestnut band across the upper breast; rest of the underparts dull white with buff flanks; tail dark brown with bright rufous bases to the outer feathers; bill black; dark eye; legs dark brown.
art.pose: standing on the ground at the foot of a low shrub, side view
art.scene: Korean marsh during spring migration: uneven wet ground with scattered low shrubs; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male, spring, side view standing on the ground with the tail slightly cocked: sepia-brown crown and nape with dark feather centres, creamy supercilium, black lores, rusty-brown ear coverts, cobalt-blue throat with a large rusty-red central spot, black, white and chestnut bands below it, rufous tail base, black bill, dark brown legs

adult female, side view standing: upperparts as the male, creamy-white throat framed by a blackish malar stripe that joins a band of dark spots across the upper breast, sometimes a little blue and rufous in this band, rufous tail base
art.build: Small, plump chat, slightly larger than a sparrow, with long legs for its size and an upright stance; runs on the ground and stops with the tail cocked and partly fanned. Bill thin, straight and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs long, slender, dark brown. Wings short and rounded: at rest the wingtips reach just past the base of the tail. Tail medium length, square, dark brown with conspicuous rufous-chestnut panels at the base of each side, flashing when the tail is spread; no wing-bars.
avoid: Do not paint a red throat with a white moustache stripe; that is Siberian Rubythroat (Calliope calliope). The Bluethroat's throat is blue.
Do not paint blue on the crown, back or wings as on Siberian Blue Robin (Larvivora cyane); the upperparts are plain brown.
Do not paint a white spot in the blue throat; birds in Korea have a rusty-red spot.
Do not omit the rufous panels at the base of the tail or the pale supercilium.
